clue.text: Goodbye and thank you for the dance

parts.note: vale is Latin for farewell
ta is informal British for thanks

explanation.surface: A partner leaves the ballroom with a polite farewell after the dance.
explanation.definitionFit: A valeta is an old-time round dance in triple time, popular in British ballrooms.

clue.text: Is it after five or later he calls?

indicators.note: places the words is it after the five

parts.note: V is the Roman numeral for five
taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone wonders whether a caller will come after five or later.
explanation.definitionFit: A visitor is someone who calls, in the sense of paying a call at a house.

clue.text: Left port carrying cargo

parts.note: Aden is a port in Yemen

explanation.surface: A ship left harbour with its hold full.
explanation.definitionFit: Laden means loaded, heavily burdened, as a ship carrying cargo is.

clue.text: I take key and lock out wild animal

indicators.note: the lock stands outside, holding the other letters within it

parts.note: a lock of hair is a tress
taken as written
G is a musical key

explanation.surface: Someone grabs a key and locks out a dangerous beast.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lock out' is not shutting out: the lock (TRESS) goes outside I plus G.
explanation.definitionFit: A tigress is a female tiger, a wild animal.

clue.text: Pointless advance warning?

definitions.meaning: with its tip taken off, a thing has no point

explanation.surface: Someone grumbles that a warning given in advance was useless.
explanation.definitionFit: Read literally, something with its tip off has lost its point; a tip-off is also an informer's warning.

clue.text: Icy blockhouses

parts.note: dwellings built from blocks of packed snow, as Inuit shelters are, rather than military forts

explanation.surface: Frozen military fortifications.
explanation.definitionFit: Inuit snow houses are made of blocks of compacted snow, so are literally houses of icy blocks.

clue.text: Big egg producers from nothing, on the way to wealth

parts.note: O is the zero symbol, nothing
ST is the abbreviation for street, a way
riches means wealth

explanation.surface: From nothing, someone is on the road to a fortune.
explanation.walkthrough: 'From nothing ... to wealth' suggests rags to riches; 'on' and 'to' just link the pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: The largest living bird lays the largest eggs of any bird.

clue.text: Money can be converted into capital

definitions.text: Money can be converted into capital

parts.words: Money can be converted into capital
parts.note: funds put up to back a business become its capital

explanation.surface: Cash can be turned into investment capital.
explanation.definitionFit: Finance is money resources, which when raised for a business forms its capital.

clue.text: What fish may do here, so a titbit is prepared

indicators.note: prepared means made ready, worked into a new form, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: An angler prepares a tasty morsel to tempt fish here.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is prepared' signals rearranging HERE plus SO A TITBIT.
explanation.definitionFit: A fish that comes up to take a bait does this literally; figuratively the phrase means reacting to provocation.

clue.text: Spent American notes

parts.note: E and D are two musical notes

explanation.surface: Someone has spent their dollar bills.
explanation.definitionFit: Spent and used both describe something already consumed or worn out.

clue.text: Limit parliamentary debate on capital punishment

definitions.meaning: a Westminster procedure that fixes a time to end debate on a bill
the beheading machine of the French Revolution

explanation.surface: A motion to cut short a debate about the death penalty.
explanation.walkthrough: In the UK Parliament a 'guillotine' motion sets strict time limits on debating a bill.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses are established: a beheading device and a procedure curtailing debate in Parliament.

clue.text: It can make one act straightaway

indicators.note: the phrase says the following letters can be rearranged to make something new

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A remark that something could turn a single act into an immediate one.
explanation.walkthrough: 'It can make' signals rearranging ONE ACT.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means immediately, without delay, exactly as straightaway does.

clue.text: Time soon modifies feelings

indicators.note: to modify is to alter, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Time will soon change how we feel.
explanation.definitionFit: Emotions are synonyms for feelings, both plural nouns for states of mind.

clue.text: Plenty in favour of a merger

parts.note: pro means for, supporting
a fusion is a joining together of two things

explanation.surface: Lots of people support a company merger.
explanation.definitionFit: Profusion means abundance, a great quantity, which is what plenty means as a noun.

clue.text: Van driver's warning about the main part

parts.note: a golfer who hits a drive shouts fore to warn others
van, short for vanguard, means the front

explanation.surface: A van driver shouts a warning about the important bit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Van' looks like a vehicle and 'driver' its driver, but van is the front and the driver a golfer; 'about' just links.
explanation.definitionFit: The forefront is the leading or most prominent part of something.

clue.text: Worn part of a brake

parts.note: the curved block pressed against a wheel in a drum brake, which wears down; the same word names something worn on the foot

explanation.surface: A mechanic points to the part of the brake that has worn away.
explanation.definitionFit: The friction block of a drum brake is named after the item of footwear, and both are worn.

clue.text: One possibly in the lead as a conductor

definitions.text: One possibly in the lead as a conductor

parts.words: One possibly in the lead as a conductor
parts.note: inside an electrical lead or cable is the central wire that carries the current

explanation.surface: Someone at the head of an orchestra, perhaps leading as conductor.
explanation.definitionFit: The core of a cable is the inner wire that conducts electricity within the lead.

clue.text: He gathers the harvest in the fall

definitions.meaning: one who cuts or gathers crops
to come a ... is to take a heavy fall

explanation.surface: A farm worker takes a tumble during harvest time.
explanation.definitionFit: A cropper is a crop-gatherer, and in the idiom 'come a cropper' it means a heavy fall.

clue.text: Vocal stallholder

parts.note: a singer who sits in the choir stalls of a church, rather than a loud market trader

explanation.surface: A market trader loudly calling out wares.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Stallholder' suggests a market, but the stalls are the choir seats in a church.
explanation.definitionFit: A member of a church choir sings from the choir stalls, so is a singing stall occupant.

clue.text: Income from flat in French street

indicators.note: the flat goes inside the street

parts.note: rue is French for street
even means flat, level

explanation.surface: Earnings from an apartment on a Paris street.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flat' looks like an apartment but means level: EVEN.
explanation.definitionFit: Revenue is income, especially money received by a business or state.

clue.text: Water at the mouth

parts.note: the tidal stretch where a river meets the sea, not saliva

explanation.surface: Someone's mouth is watering.
explanation.definitionFit: An estuary is the wide tidal mouth of a river where it meets the sea.

clue.text: Record turnover is not commonly a cause of prosecution

indicators.note: the record is turned over, read backwards

parts.note: LP is a long-playing record
ain't is the colloquial form of is not

explanation.surface: A firm's record turnover is not usually a reason for being taken to court.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turnover' reads as business income, but it reverses LP to PL.
explanation.definitionFit: In law a plaint is the written statement of a grievance that starts an action.

clue.text: Driver, perhaps, doing the rounds in a cart

definitions.text: Driver, perhaps, doing the rounds in a cart

parts.words: Driver, perhaps, doing the rounds in a cart
parts.note: a driver is a type of golf stick, carried in a buggy round the course

explanation.surface: A delivery driver doing rounds in a horse-drawn cart.
explanation.definitionFit: A driver is one kind of golf stick, carried round the course in a golf cart.

clue.text: A case of excessive pride

definitions.meaning: a ... case is a small bag for cosmetics
conceit about one's appearance or abilities

explanation.surface: An example of someone being far too proud.
explanation.definitionFit: A vanity case is a make-up bag, and vanity itself means conceit or self-admiration.

clue.text: Nearly time to see the moon?

definitions.text: Nearly time to see the moon?

parts.note: nigh means nearly, close

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether it is almost the hour for moon-watching.
explanation.definitionFit: The moon is usually seen in the dark hours after sunset, which is the time named.

clue.text: Work on site can cause obstruction

parts.note: op is short for opus, a work
a site is a position or location

explanation.surface: Building work on a site can block the road.
explanation.definitionFit: Opposition is resistance, something that stands in the way, as obstruction does.

clue.text: Trendy clothes changed on inclination

definitions.meaning: a driver changes this when going up or down a slope

explanation.surface: Someone changes into fashionable clothes on a whim.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Inclination' looks like a whim, but it is a hill on which a driver changes down.
explanation.definitionFit: Gear is informal for clothes, and a vehicle's gear is what gets changed on a slope.

clue.text: In turn it's consumed with decay

parts.note: rot is decay
ate means consumed, eaten

explanation.surface: In turn, something is eaten away by rot.
explanation.definitionFit: To rotate is to turn about an axis, a direct verb synonym.

clue.text: Upper-class people discovered in low-down attempt

parts.note: the low-down is inside information, informally gen
a try is an attempt

explanation.surface: Aristocrats are found out in an underhand attempt.
explanation.definitionFit: The gentry are the class of people just below the nobility, well-born and propertied.
